mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 8%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below the 5-year average signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS is below 5-year average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below the 5-year average signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below 5-year average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in UNRATE above 8% and a 3-month decline in PAYEMS below the 5-year average signals severe labor market distress, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8.0% AND PAYEMS falls below 5-year average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both triggers occur, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in HOUST below the 5-year average signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST is below 5-year average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in GDPC1 above the 5-year average signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 > 5-year average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
